lines: Aashray for Hope. Aashray for Dignity. Aashray for Everyone.

Born from a simple act of community care during the 2020 lockdown, Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation brings people together to support relief, wellbeing, education and opportunities for a better future.

sections.heading: Our story began in 2020
lines: It started with a few friends, a few rotis, and faith in people.

During the COVID-19 lockdown, a group of friends in Siliguri came together as Bharosa Group to help people who needed food. Through the Roti Challenge, families contributed rotis once a week. Volunteers collected the contributions from homes, packed the food at the team’s work location and went out to distribute meals.
That spirit of participation continues in Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation.
Button  Read Our Story  →  /about-us

sections.heading: Our six impact areas
lines: Immediate care and longer-term opportunity belong together. Aashray’s work and future plans are organised around six areas, each with a clear stage of progress.
Children & Education — Upcoming computer training to help students build practical digital skills.
Health & Wellbeing — Building on health-related work already undertaken in the community.
Women & Livelihood — Planned opportunities for skills, confidence and livelihood development.
Community & Relief — Food and clothing support rooted in the foundation’s early work.
Environment & Animal Welfare — Planned care for our surroundings and the animals with whom we share them.
Human Rights — Planned awareness and community support centred on dignity and inclusion.

sections.heading: Our work and next steps
lines: Community & Relief and Health & Wellbeing are areas where Aashray has already undertaken ground work. Computer training is the next education initiative in preparation. Our remaining pillars describe the direction we intend to grow into as programs are developed.

name: About Us

sections.heading: Hero
lines: From Bharosa to Aashray.
A journey that began during a crisis has grown into a commitment to dignity, opportunity and community support.

sections.heading: Where it started
lines: In 2020, the COVID-19 lockdown made everyday life difficult for many people. A group of friends in Siliguri came together under the name Bharosa Group to respond with food support.
The effort began with people helping wherever they could. It was built on participation, practical action and concern for those struggling to arrange a meal.

sections.heading: The Roti Challenge begins
lines: Families who accepted the Roti Challenge prepared rotis for contribution once a week. The organisation’s team collected the rotis from participating homes, brought the food to its work location for packing and then went out to distribute meals.
This simple model gave families a direct way to take part in community care. Their kitchens became part of a shared effort, alongside the volunteers who collected, packed and distributed the food.
Button  Read the Roti Challenge Story  →  /roti-challenge

sections.heading: The journey forward
lines: The community effort that began as Bharosa Group is now carried forward through Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation. Food and clothing distribution, along with health-related work, form part of the foundation’s experience.
Aashray is preparing an upcoming computer training program and plans to develop work across six impact pillars. Each area will grow with the preparation, people and resources it needs.

sections.heading: Our mission
lines: To support individuals and communities with dignity through relief, wellbeing, learning opportunities and meaningful community participation.

sections.heading: Our vision
lines: Over the next three to five years, we aim to become a trusted community organisation across North Bengal, building on our Siliguri roots and creating lasting opportunities for people who need support.

sections.heading: What guides us
lines: Dignity — Support should respect the person receiving it.
Community — People can contribute in different ways, and each contribution matters.
Compassion — We begin by listening and understanding.
Integrity — We describe our work and plans honestly.
Inclusion — We seek to make participation and opportunity more accessible.
Action — Care becomes meaningful when people turn it into practical support.

sections.heading: The people behind Aashray
lines: Aashray’s journey has been shaped by the people who contributed food, time and effort. As the foundation grows, its leadership and volunteers carry forward that community spirit.

name: Roti Challenge

sections.heading: Hero
lines: The Roti Challenge
When a community turned its kitchens into a movement.
During the 2020 lockdown, Bharosa Group created a simple way for families to help people who were struggling for food. That idea became the Roti Challenge.

sections.heading: How it worked
lines: 1. Families accepted the challenge. Participating households chose to contribute rotis once a week.
2. Rotis were prepared at home. Each family’s contribution became part of a shared community effort.
3. The team collected from homes. Volunteers visited the households that had accepted the challenge.
4. Food was packed together. The collected rotis and other food were brought to the team’s work location for packing.
5. Volunteers went out to distribute. The team took the packed meals to people who needed food support.

sections.heading: It was never just about roti
lines: The Roti Challenge gave people a simple way to take part. Families contributed from their homes, while volunteers carried out the collection, packing and distribution.
Each part of the effort depended on the others. Together, those contributions helped turn concern for the community into meals and practical support.

sections.heading: The challenge that shaped Aashray
lines: The Roti Challenge remains an important part of our story. Its spirit continues to influence Aashray’s direction: creating ways for ordinary people to become part of community care.

sections.heading: Memories from 2020
lines: Our archive will bring together photographs and video memories from the initiative, preserving the work and participation behind the Roti Challenge.

These terms describe the use of the website of Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation. Please read them alongside our Privacy Policy and, where relevant, our Donation and Refund Policy.

sections.heading: Purpose of the website
lines: The website provides information about the foundation, its story, work and planned initiatives. It also allows visitors to submit enquiries about volunteering, partnerships and support. Program announcements describe the stage and details confirmed at the time of publication.

sections.heading: Using the website
lines: Please use the website responsibly. Do not submit false information, impersonate another person, misuse forms, upload harmful content or attempt to interfere with the website or its records.

sections.heading: Information and program availability
lines: We aim to keep website information clear and accurate. Historical activities, upcoming programs and planned initiatives are identified separately. Program dates, eligibility and availability will be announced when confirmed and may be updated.
Submitting an enquiry does not confirm enrolment, a volunteer role, a partnership or an agreed contribution arrangement.

sections.heading: Content and permissions
lines: The foundation’s website text, identity and approved media should be used with respect for the rights of the foundation and the people represented. Contact us before reproducing photographs, videos, logos or substantial website content. Materials belonging to third parties remain subject to their permissions.

sections.heading: External websites
lines: Links to social platforms, partners or service providers may take you to websites operated by others. Review their policies before submitting information or making use of their services.

sections.heading: Support and contributions
lines: Contribution methods, purpose restrictions, receipt arrangements and applicable donation terms must be confirmed before a contribution is accepted. Tax benefits or foreign-contribution eligibility are not implied by an enquiry or by the presence of this website. Refer to the Donation and Refund Policy for the approved process.
